title: Use of Probiotic Bacteria in Prevention of Allergic Disease in Children 1999-2008
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to find out if allergic diseases can be prevented buy giving probiotic bacteria to pregnant mothers and their newborn infants
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* mother or father fo child with doctor diagnoses allergic disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* prematurity, major malformations
